title: feat(types,plugin-timeline)!: declare the timeline item — a feed item or a gantt row, judged by variant (objectui#6356)
body:
Fixes #6356

Clause-②: yes

Implements the maintainer ruling on objectui#6356 (comment `5857468846`: Q1 「A 内部键(推荐)」, Q2 「C 联合+校验判别(推荐)」). The first dev's measurement (`5857222802`, Tables 1–3) is the starting data and was not re-derived. Generics are spelled in words on purpose (GitHub strips tag-shaped text from bodies).

## What changes for an author

| input | before (base `c58b8e4a0`) | after |
|---|---|---|
| a gantt row on a `vertical` / `horizontal` / variant-absent timeline | validates, draws an empty entry, no diagnostic | refused: `custom` at `items.0.title`, `items.0.label`, `items.0.items` |
| a feed item on a `gantt` timeline | validates, draws an empty unlabelled row | refused: `custom` at `items.0.label`, `items.0.time`, `items.0.title` |
| a feed item with no `title` / a gantt row with no `label` | validates | refused at that key |
| item or bar `variant` outside the documented five | validates | refused, `invalid_value` |
| `{ title, date }` in TypeScript | compiles, `date` silently dropped | TS2353 excess property, names `date` |
| a fresh literal passed to `TimelineRenderer`'s `schema` prop whose item carries an undeclared key (e.g. `date`) | compiles | TS2353 — the prop is the renderer's handoff type; values typed `TimelineSchema` and the composed keys still type-check |
| `meta` / `group` / `color` / `startDate` / `endDate` / `_data` on the strict authoring face | refused, but so was every legitimate key | refused BY NAME (`unrecognized_keys`, keys = that one key); the catalog documents now pass |
| the schema-catalog documents, strict face | every element refused (Table 3) | accepted |
| a `null` row / a non-array row `items` / a `null` bar (objectui#7164, objectui#7365) | refused at `items.0`, `items.0.items`, `items.0.items.0` | unchanged — same paths, same `invalid_type` |

Public door, measured with `safeValidateSchema` (what `objectui validate` runs): the vertical-timeline gantt row above answers `custom @ items.0.title`, `items.0.label`, `items.0.items`.

## Ruling → implementation

- **Q1 = A.** `TimelineFeedItem` (TS) and `TimelineFeedItemSchema` (zod) declare exactly `time, title, description, variant, icon, content, className`. The composed-only keys are typed ONLY in `packages/plugin-timeline/src/renderHandoff.ts` (`TimelineRenderFeedItem`, `TimelineRenderSchema`) — not exported from the plugin's index, not in `@object-ui/types`. `TimelineRenderer`'s `schema` prop is that handoff type, so the renderer keeps reading them (lenient renderer, strict validation).
- **Q2 = C.** TS element = `TimelineFeedItem` or `TimelineGanttItem` (closed arms). The zod `TimelineSchema` stays a `ZodObject` ending in `.superRefine(timelineItemsFitVariant)`, which judges each element against the arm `variant` selects (absent ⇒ vertical): the arm's required key must be present, and no key the OTHER arm declares may be. Feed `title` and gantt `label` are required; element and bar `variant` are the documented five (`TimelineItemVariant`). The two `.extend` control sites moved to `.safeExtend`.
- **Retirement posture.** Composed-only keys are refused by name on the strict face immediately; no alias, no window.

## Zone 2 — the PM's mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **Holds** at base `c58b8e4a0`: `items` was `z.array(TimelineRowSchema)` with `.passthrough()` element and bar, and a string-index TS element.
2. **Holds — all four survive C.** Measured on zod 4.4.3: the node stays `ZodObject` (one check), `.shape` intact; `DataDisplaySchema` still dispatches to it and the refinement fires through the union; the parity ratchet reads `.shape` (types `type-check` green, including `tsconfig.test.json`); `timeScale` / `body` / `children` still answer `invalid_type` at their key; `events` / `orientation` / `position` pins unchanged. `.extend()` over an existing key throws (`Cannot overwrite keys on object schemas containing refinements`); `.safeExtend()` keeps the refinement.
   - ⚠️ **One finding that shaped the zod face.** The literal mirror of "TS element union" — an element-level `z.union` of the two arms — was measured to fold every element-level refusal into ONE `invalid_union` at `items.0` (both arms fail), which would move objectui#7164's and objectui#7365's pinned paths (`items.0.items`, `items.0.items.0`) and name an unknown key twice on the strict face. So the node's SHAPE declares both arms' keys (each optional) and the refinement picks the arm. The element's static type is asserted to the declaration's union, because that is the NODE's accept set; without it the parity ratchet would read `items` as wider than declared. `TimelineSchema.shape.items` parsed alone judges no arm — the docblock says so. Same spelling as `nodeUnion` in `base.zod.ts`.
3. **Holds.** PR objectui#10714 was still an open draft when `main` was merged, so there was nothing new to re-read. Shared files: `data-display.ts` / `data-display.zod.ts` — that PR edits the `ListSchema` / `ListItem` region, this one the timeline region; no symbol is shared, so a text merge is the only overlap to expect.
4. **Holds.** `ObjectTimeline.test.tsx`'s two `{ title, date }` items are re-spelled `time`, and the two schemas are now typed `ObjectTimelineProps['schema']` instead of `any`, so the compiler now refuses `date` there (the reverse check below uses exactly that line).

## Choices beyond the ruling's letter — for the contract review

- **Registered mirror pairs.** `TimelineFeedItemSchema`, `TimelineGanttItemSchema`, `TimelineGanttItemBarSchema` are exported and registered in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` (`EXPECTED_MIRROR_PAIRS` 159 → 162, the only edit that ledger asks for). The old "not exported" reason was that the TS twin had no interface to pair with; it has now, and the pairing is what keeps the element keys from drifting under the static assertion. They are on the `./zod` barrel like every other nested mirror.
- **New public TS names:** `TimelineFeedItem`, `TimelineGanttItem`, `TimelineGanttItemBar`, `TimelineItemVariant`. Named to avoid the plugin's `TimelineItem` / `TimelineGanttRow` / `TimelineGanttBar` component exports.
- **Requiredness kept to the ruling:** only feed `title` and gantt `label`. `time` stays optional; every bar key stays optional (a bar with unusable dates still reaches the render-time `unusableRange` diagnostic).
- **Bar date type** = string, finite number or `Date` — the renderer's own ruled rule (objectui#6781), not the docs' "ISO string", so the kept epoch capability is not refused at validate.
- **`TimelineGanttItemBar` is a `type` alias**, not an interface: an interface has no implicit index signature, and the parity ratchet read the gantt pair's `items` as narrower-than-declared for that reason alone.

## Verification — round-1 head `42ef5763f`

> Seat note: the final head is `11725ece9` (merge of `main` at `9a5f99880` plus a changeset-only commit from the patch round after contract review `5858250761`). The patch round's readings are in its report on objectui#6356; the readings below are round 1's.

All heavy runs via `os-verify-lock.sh`; exit codes captured by redirect-then-status.

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (tsc + examples + test program) → exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build` → exit 0; `dist/data-display.d.ts` carries `TimelineFeedItem`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-timeline type-check` (reads `@object-ui/types` from the rebuilt dist) → exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ packages/plugin-timeline/ --maxWorkers=2` → `Test Files 280 passed (280)`, `Tests 5722 passed (5722)`, exit 0.
- **Reverse check across the package boundary** (`ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode): planting `date` on the typed item in `ObjectTimeline.test.tsx` → plugin-timeline's test program answers `TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'date' does not exist in type 'TimelineFeedItem | TimelineGanttItem'`, exit 2; restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablation** (`ablation-replace.mjs`): dropping `.superRefine(timelineItemsFitVariant)` turns exactly the 10 refinement-dependent pins of `timeline-item-element-6356.test.ts` red (the strict-face by-name and vocabulary pins stay green, as they should); restored blob == HEAD. The pin file imports `../zod/data-display.zod.js` relatively, so no `dist/` is on that path.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-example-readers`, changeset presence / no-major / claims → all exit 0. `check:component-surface-parity` is report-only; its one timeline row (`plugin-timeline:timeline.scale`) exists on base too — only its line moved.
- eslint over the 12 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files (root config, no type-aware linting, so no untouched file's verdict can move) → 12 files, 0 errors.
- `check:doc-snippets`, after its own declared build closure (`turbo run build` over `--build-filter`, exit 0) → `Semantic phase: 676 of 676 block(s) judged, 0 failed.`, exit 0. The timeline page's `TimelineSchema`-typed `tsx` blocks are in its default-covered set (the gate script names no exclusion for it). `check:doc-examples` → exit 0.

## Not measured locally, declared

- `type-check` of `@object-ui/types`' other dependents: not run locally. `TimelineSchema` is imported only by `plugin-timeline` (git grep over `packages/`, `apps/`, `examples/`), and no TypeScript outside these two packages writes a `type: 'timeline'` component literal with `items` (the six hits are list-view `type: 'timeline'`). CI runs the full set.
- Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full `pnpm test`: CI-owned.

## Acceptance notes

- The pending objectui#7164 and objectui#7365 changesets say a row's and a bar's own keys stay undeclared and feed timelines are untouched. They publish in the same release; this PR's changeset names what it supersedes rather than rewriting their records.
- `packages/plugin-timeline/README.md` "Schema-Driven Usage" spells the node `component: 'timeline'`; `safeValidateSchema` refuses that document (`invalid_union @ type`) and accepts it spelled `type`. Different defect class from this card; reported to the seat, not fixed here.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/TIMELINE.md` still lists three gantt scales (first dev's finding); untouched.
- objectstack follow-up (`object-timeline.items` taking this vocabulary) is the seat's to file on landing, per Q3.
